description: Distinct countries on /api/v1/trails. Figures are sourced and dated. They may be provisional. Cite the trail URL and the verifiedDate. Permit status is verified-official, reported-secondary, or unverified, or null when the feed has none. Null means not recorded. This server does not invent figures. A returned figure can be verified with get_provenance and the record signature.
